# Handoff AI Coaching

> One-on-one AI coaching and AI product design by Ethan Allen in Sebastopol, California. Ethan teaches people and businesses to use Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity for real work, in person around the San Francisco Bay Area or by video anywhere. He also designs the user experience for companies building AI products. Founded October 2026. Handoff AI Coaching has no connection to Handoff (handoff.ai), the estimating software for contractors and remodelers.

## AI coaching

Sessions happen on the client's own computer, on real work from their week. Everything set up stays in the client's own accounts. Clients pay for their AI subscriptions directly; Handoff doesn't resell them.

- Free 20-minute intro call by phone or video.
- Single session: $225 for 90 minutes, in person or by video.
- Getting Started: $595 for three 90-minute sessions over about three weeks.
- Set-Up Day on site: $795 half day, $1,395 full day.
- Small-team workshop: $1,500 for 3 hours, up to 8 people, on site.
- Standing Hour: $395 a month for two 60-minute sessions, month to month.
- Business setup: $1,395, a full day on site or by video setting up Claude to help run a one-person business or home office.
- Team setup: $2,695 (saves $200 vs. booking a full Set-Up Day and the workshop separately), for an owner plus up to 8 people.
- Extra time $175 an hour. Travel included within about 20 miles of Sebastopol. 15% off for nonprofits and educators.
- What clients learn: Projects that know their work, connecting email, calendar and files, letting the assistant work on their computer with approvals, scheduled tasks that run on their own, drafts that sound like them, and using AI safely.
- Service area: in person from Sonoma County to San Francisco, the East Bay and the Peninsula; everywhere else by video on Pacific time.

## AI product design

For startups and product teams building AI products. Fixed scope and price in writing before work starts, from $4,800.

- AI UX audits, design sprints and a fractional design lead.
- Free 30-minute product review: Ethan uses the product first, then walks the team through what he'd improve.
- Remote on Pacific time, or in person around the Bay Area.

## Handoff Logbook

An add-on for Claude, made by Ethan Allen. Claude checks what you've already told it before it answers, and writes down what it did before it stops, so new chats start caught up on your business. It needs a paid Claude plan and the current Claude desktop app on a Mac (on Team and Enterprise plans an admin may need to allow plugins first), plus Python 3; Windows is coming. It isn't made by or affiliated with Anthropic.

- Founding seat: $99 one time, a founding price for a limited time. Version 1.0 ships by Monday, November 9, 2026, with a setup guide, email support and a group call with Ethan on Fridays, November 6, 13 and 20. Full refund any time before it ships and for 30 days after.
- Install with Ethan: $395 one time, a 90-minute video call setting it up on your business. Handoff Logbook included.
- Page: https://handoffcoaching.com/logbook.html

### Handoff Logbook questions

- What do I need? A paid Claude plan (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise) and the current Claude desktop app on a Mac. On Team and Enterprise plans, your admin may need to allow plugins first. Windows is coming. Setup checks that your Mac has Python 3 and walks you through adding it if it doesn't.
- Where does my business information go? It stays in your own Claude account. The add-on sends nothing to Ethan or anyone else. It keeps a small log on your Mac so the weekly score can check it ran.
- What if Claude skips a step? At the end of every reply the add-on checks that Claude read your logbook and noted any changes. If it didn't, it sends Claude back to finish.
- Does it work when I use Claude on my phone? It works in chats on your Mac today. Chats started on the phone are still being tested, and founders will hear as soon as that's confirmed.
- Can I see what Claude keeps track of? Anytime. It's a plain page in your own Claude account.
- Who makes it? Ethan Allen, through Handoff AI Coaching in Sebastopol, California. It works with Claude, which is made by Anthropic.

## About Ethan Allen

- Product designer and photographer, 30 years of experience.
- Founded Raspberry Media in 1995, the Silicon Valley design agency that did the first redesigns of eBay and Match.com; Match.com grew from 300,000 to 1.2 million members during that work.
- Designed the user experience for Snapfish in 1999. PC Data ranked it the No. 1 online photo service in June 2000, and HP bought it in 2005 for a reported $300 million.
- Worked on more than 50 product launches for companies including TiVo, Best Buy, Capital One, HP and Canvas Technology (bought by Amazon in 2019).
- AI products since 2016: fleet controls for Canvas Technology's self-driving warehouse carts, the LVIS NeuroMatch AI-assisted EEG reader for neurologists (design lead, 2022–2025), and Palo, chat-based AI tools for YouTube Shorts creators (design lead, 2025).
- Has photographed for GQ, French Vogue and Rolling Stone; FAA Part 107 drone pilot.
- Handoff is independent of Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Perplexity.
